en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an old stone house with a wooden arched door, cracked masonry, and a leafless tree leaning across the foreground. A rectangular window with metal bars is visible on the right side. Below the image there is multilingual caption text in Greek and French identifying the location in Ierapetra, Crete, and mentioning that Napoleon spent a night there. The web address "www.elia.org.gr" is printed over the lower right corner.
